data.name: Akshay
data.long_meaning: The name Akshay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akshaya’, which means ‘never-ending’, ‘unending’, or ‘immortal’. In Hindu mythology, the god of immortality is named Akshaya, and the name is also associated with Lord Vishnu. Akshay signifies the eternal and infinite nature of the universe and the self.

In various regional cultures, Akshay is celebrated on particular festive days or occasions, such as Akshaya Tritiya, a significant festival for buying new gold or other valuable possessions as it is believed that the name Akshay bestows wealth and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Akshaya Tritiya, a Hindu festival celebrated on the third day (Tritiya) of the Shukla Paksha (bright fortnight) in the Hindu calendar month of Vaishakha.
